ideas.title: The Rise of Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: An investigation into the surge of medicaid fraud cases in Minnesota, including the 11,000% surge in medicaid autism spending.
questions: What is causing the surge in medicaid fraud?
How can we prevent medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the causes and consequences of medicaid fraud in Minnesota, potentially uncovering a larger pattern of financial crimes.

ideas.title: Mortgage Fraud in Minnesota

ideas.insight: This story would analyze data on mortgage fraud cases in Minnesota, potentially uncovering a larger pattern of financial crimes.
